prompt:
OUTBREAK GENESIS - PROMPT 1: FOUNDATION BUILD

Create the foundation for a polished Roblox third-person co-op roguelite shooter called Outbreak Genesis.

Do not attempt to build the entire game at once. Focus on creating a stable, expandable foundation with clean scripts, organised folders, and reusable systems.

CORE GAMEPLAY

The player fights increasingly difficult waves of infected mutants inside a ruined futuristic city.

Use a third-person, over-the-shoulder camera with smooth movement and responsive combat.

The player should be able to:

- Walk and run smoothly
- Sprint
- Jump
- Dodge roll in the movement direction
- Manually aim using a crosshair
- Shoot toward the crosshair
- Reload their weapon
- Take damage and die
- Play comfortably on PC, mobile, and controller

The camera should remain behind the player and shift slightly over the right shoulder while aiming.

STARTER WEAPON

Give every player a basic futuristic assault rifle.

The rifle should include:

- Automatic firing
- Visible muzzle flash
- Bullet tracer effect
- Shooting sound
- Reload animation or reload delay
- Magazine ammunition
- Reserve ammunition
- Damage falloff over long distances
- Crosshair feedback when an enemy is hit
- Red crosshair feedback when an enemy is eliminated

Use raycasting for accurate shooting.

ENEMY SYSTEM

Create one basic infected enemy called Crawler.

The Crawler should:

- Spawn from designated enemy spawn points
- Detect the nearest living player
- Chase the player using pathfinding
- Attack at close range
- Take damage from weapons
- Display a health bar
- Play a death effect
- Drop XP crystals when defeated
- Automatically despawn after death

Enemies should be controlled by the server to reduce exploits.

WAVE SYSTEM

Create a basic wave manager.

Requirements:

- Begin Wave 1 after a short countdown
- Spawn a set number of Crawlers
- Increase the number and health of enemies each wave
- Detect when all enemies have been defeated
- Display the current wave number
- Provide a short break between waves
- Start the next wave automatically
- End the match when every player is dead

For this first build, support at least 10 waves.

XP AND LEVEL-UP SYSTEM

Defeated enemies should drop glowing XP crystals.

When a player moves close to a crystal, it should fly toward them and be collected.

Add:

- XP bar
- Player level
- Increasing XP requirements
- A level-up effect
- A temporary pause or protected state during upgrade selection

Whenever the player levels up, display three randomly selected upgrades.

The player chooses one upgrade, and the other two disappear.

Starter upgrades should include:

- Increased weapon damage
- Increased fire rate
- Increased magazine size
- Faster reload speed
- Increased movement speed
- Increased maximum health
- Health regeneration
- Additional projectile
- Critical-hit chance

Upgrades should stack and visibly affect gameplay.

USER INTERFACE

Create a clean sci-fi HUD displaying:

- Health bar
- XP bar
- Current level
- Current wave
- Remaining enemies
- Magazine and reserve ammunition
- Crosshair
- Sprint indicator or stamina bar
- Three-card upgrade selection screen

Keep the interface readable on mobile devices.

TEST MAP

Create a small ruined-city test arena containing:

- Broken roads
- Abandoned vehicles
- Damaged buildings
- Concrete barriers
- Flickering lights
- Fog or atmospheric particles
- Several enemy spawn points
- Open areas for fighting
- Obstacles enemies must navigate around

Use simple placeholder assets where necessary. Prioritise performance and gameplay functionality over detailed decoration.

TECHNICAL STRUCTURE

Organise the project using clear folders and reusable ModuleScripts.

Separate systems for:

- Player movement
- Camera
- Weapons
- Enemy AI
- Wave management
- XP and levelling
- Upgrade selection
- UI
- RemoteEvents
- Game configuration

Use server-authoritative damage, enemy spawning, XP rewards, and wave progression.

Add comments explaining important scripts.

The finished build should provide a playable prototype where players can enter the arena, fight waves of Crawlers, collect XP, level up, select upgrades, and continue until they die.
enriched: Create a compact 3D test arena set in a ruined futuristic city for a third-person co-op roguelite shooter. The environment features broken roads weaving through the scene with scattered abandoned vehicles and damaged buildings forming partial cover and obstacles. Concrete barriers and flickering streetlights add atmospheric detail, while light fog and subtle particle effects enhance the mood. Several designated enemy spawn points are placed around the map, positioned to allow Crawlers to pathfind through open fighting areas and navigate around obstacles. The layout balances open zones for combat with tighter spaces for tactical movement. The camera perspective is over-the-shoulder behind the player, slightly offset to the right when aiming, ensuring clear sightlines. The scene prioritizes performance and gameplay functionality using simple placeholder assets, focusing on a stable, expandable foundation for smooth player movement, responsive combat, and wave-based enemy encounters within this atmospheric urban ruin.
